derivation: a form for H3564 (כּוּר) (only in the dual);
def: a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set)

occurrences.text: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
